coverage_note: City of Seattle permits only (King County page scope). County-wide coverage is NOT implied.

dedupe_rule.definition: A 'permit' for Seattle = one permitnum issued by Seattle SDCI. The feed carries exactly one row per permit, so no collapsing is needed or applied.
dedupe_rule.measurement_2026_10_18: Trailing-12-month issue window (issueddate >= 2025-10-17): 6,348 rows vs count(distinct permitnum) 6,348. All-time: 193,745 rows vs 193,745 distinct permitnum. Identity holds dataset-wide, not just in the window.
dedupe_rule.rule: source_record_id = permitnum. The pipeline's in-batch duplicate gate and the DB upsert key (county_id, source_record_id) remain as guards; measured duplicates at build: 0.
dedupe_rule.valuation_warning: Permit IDENTITY is unique, but estimated project cost is NOT project-unique: SDCI stamps a development's full estimated cost onto each of its phase/sibling permits (demolition, grading, phased construction). See field_map.valuation — this is why Seattle publishes counts only.

field_map.category: permitclassmapped (Residential / Non-Residential — published for 100% of window rows)
field_map.contractor_rule: contractorcompanyname ONLY (business name as published; present on 536 of 6,348 window rows). The dataset publishes NO applicant/owner person-name fields at all (verified against the full 41-column schema, 2026-10-18), and the pull is additionally column-restricted by pull_select.
field_map.source_record_id: permitnum — verified unique: window 6,348 distinct = 6,348 rows; all-time 193,745 = 193,745 (measured 2026-10-18)
field_map.valuation: estprojectcost — STORED as reported, NOT PUBLISHED (counts-only county, Austin precedent). Decision measured 2026-10-18 on the T12M issue window: coverage is excellent (6,347 of 6,348 valued; 1 null, 55 zero, 21 at $1) but the field stamps one development's full estimated cost onto every phase/sibling permit: 38 demolition permits at 36 different Northgate-area addresses each carry the identical $24,102,600; 10 demolition permits on one street each carry $50,000,000; a grading and a demolition permit for adjacent addresses each carry $127,620,000. parentpermitnum is NULL on all 6,348 window rows, so no linkage exists to dedupe by. Duplicated values over $1M alone inject $2,010,277,926 of excess — 38.5% of the raw $5,216,753,833 sum. No trustworthy aggregate exists; the raw sum is never published.
